markets.rules_primary: If the maximum temperature recorded at Miami (CLIMIA) for Sep 30, 2026, is between 84-85° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Bitcoin crosses the specified price threshold.
markets.rules_primary: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $100000.00 starting 02/17/2026 04:00 PM and before Oct 1, 2026 at 12:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

markets.rules_primary: If Volodymyr Zelenskyy has either officially announced their intention to leave as President of Ukraine or has actually left as President of Ukraine before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Death does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion for this Contract. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.

A qualifying claim must be made after Issuance and strictly before October 1, 2026 by Donald Trump or an authorized representative explicitly speaking on Trump's behalf. The public claim must expressly name at least one distinct news outlet and state that outlet is being added to or banned from White House access. Eligible forms include verified social-media posts, speeches, interviews, press conferences, official statements, press releases, official transcripts, or other public documents.

CNN, MSNOW/MSNBC (the same outlet despite the name change), and Politico are the existing excluded outlets; naming or rebranding one does not qualify. A vague statement such as 'Other Fake News Media Outlets to follow,' criticism, an unendorsed conditional or hypothetical statement, a non-rhetorical question, an anonymous or third-party report, a repost of another person's claim, an ambiguous statement, or body language does not qualify. Actual access implementation is not required.

The qualifying publication must announce a definite White House decision that the access bans on CNN, MS NOW, and Politico will end, be lifted, terminated, or rescinded, including a definite future restoration. markets.rules_primary: If the United States and Iran hold a senior-level diplomatic meeting after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify, unless the new article itself explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of the publication date. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The meeting must be deliberately convened for diplomacy or negotiation, and each country must be represented by at least one senior official who actively participates in an official capacity. It need not produce an agreement, joint statement, or commitment to further talks. Only the part of a meeting held after Issuance counts; a meeting held entirely before Issuance does not qualify, even if reported afterward.

A senior official is a head of state or government, vice president, foreign minister or other cabinet-rank minister, head of a national security council, presiding officer of a national legislature, special envoy, or anyone the head of state or government designates to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Officials whose mandate is limited to technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, or preparatory discussions do not qualify. Qualifying officials include, without limitation, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff, and Jared Kushner for the United States, and Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi, and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf for Iran.

The meeting may be direct, with the officials meeting face to face in person (interpreters permitted), or indirect, with both delegations physically present in the same facility, venue, or city for a single organized round of talks and an intermediary authorized by both governments relaying communications between them on the same calendar day in the meeting location's local time.

Phone or video contact, chance encounters, and exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities do not qualify, nor do the proceedings of standing international organizations or recurring multilateral summits such as the UN General Assembly. A separately arranged bilateral meeting held alongside such an event may qualify. A meeting does not qualify if either country is represented only by persons lacking authority to conduct diplomacy or negotiation on its behalf. The incidental presence of supporting staff does not by itself disqualify a meeting.
markets.title: Will the U.S. and Iran hold a senior-level meeting before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump publicly criticizes Flock Safety's license plate reader cameras before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves to Yes when Donald Trump, personally, makes a public statement before this market's date expressing a critical, disapproving or negative position on Flock Safety's automated license plate reader (ALPR) cameras, on Flock Safety, or on the ALPR program generally. Criticising misuse of the cameras, or objecting on privacy or civil-liberties grounds, counts.

Announcing or directing a federal restriction, ban or rollback of Flock or ALPR camera programs also resolves this market to Yes, whether or not the announcement uses critical language.

The following do NOT resolve this market to Yes:

Neutral or undecided framing, including describing the cameras as having "pros and cons" or saying the matter is under study
Statements by administration officials, surrogates or spokespeople rather than by Donald Trump personally
Reposting someone else's criticism without Trump adding his own critical comment
Criticism aimed only at one city's or state's individual contract, without extending to the cameras, the company or the program generally
Anything said before Issuance, even if reposted or referred to afterward
markets.title: Will Donald Trump publicly criticize Flock Safety's license plate reader cameras before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Serbia agrees to or announces a formal decision by the Speaker of the National Assembly calling the election for President of Serbia before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

The decision calling the election for President of Serbia must be issued by the Speaker of the National Assembly, including a Speaker serving as acting President, and must set the voting date. Statements of intent, planned or expected dates, and statements by parties, the Government or other officials do not qualify unless they officially record that the decision has been issued. The decision counts if it is signed or officially announced after Issuance and before the market's date.
markets.title: Will Serbia call its presidential election before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the function is implemented.
markets.rules_primary: If an OpenAI product has implemented a general-purpose personal AI agent that remembers the user and starts multi-step tasks across third-party apps on its own before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The function must be live and processing user interactions, not explicitly labeled as "beta," "test," "experimental," "preview," or "early access" or similar, and officially acknowledged by the company through announcements, documentation, or help pages. Implementation includes direct integration into the product's interface, automatic application to user accounts, user-initiated activation through official controls, API implementation, or policy changes that operationally enforce the function. Announcements without deployment, employee-only testing, technical documentation without implementation, and third-party additions without authorization do not qualify. The implementation must occur in the United States unless otherwise specified. If it meets these conditions, it counts from the first date it is live for users outside the company, including in a gradual rollout or a waitlist, invitation-only, or paid-tier release.

A general-purpose personal AI agent acts for an individual user on that user's own goals, is not limited to a single category of task or app, such as only code, only documents, or only shopping, and (1) retains user-specific information, such as preferences, relationships, goals, or ongoing activities, across separate interactions, and (2) as a built-in capability, on its own initiative and outside any conversation or task the user has started, begins new multi-step actions across third-party apps, websites, or services to advance the user's ongoing goals, based on what it has retained. The agent must itself take at least one such action before asking the user anything, and may then pause for approval before a step such as sending a message or making a purchase. An action means changing something in a third-party app, website, or service on the user's behalf, such as sending, posting, booking, purchasing, submitting a form, or creating, editing, or deleting an item; reading, searching, or summarizing does not count. An agent focused on work qualifies if it acts across email, calendar, messaging, and the web for an individual user.

The following do not qualify: carrying out a task the user started, however long-running; running tasks on a user-defined schedule, event trigger, or monitor, or under a standing instruction that tells the agent what to do or which app, source, or workflow to watch; a briefing or notification on its own; a proposed task or suggestion that does nothing until the user accepts it; an offer made in reply to the user's message; memory alone; an agent configured by an organization to run shared team workflows; and a developer platform, SDK, or API for building agents, unless the company itself offers through it an agent that meets (1) and (2) for end users. A goal or preference the user has shared, from which the agent itself decides what new task to start, is not a standing instruction, and neither is turning the capability on, connecting apps, or granting permissions.
markets.title: Will OpenAI release a personal AI agent before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If the President announces a new trade deal before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, an announcement must satisfy ALL of the following criteria:

Made through official channels including White House press conferences, official White House statements, presidential speeches, official presidential social media accounts, or official presidential appearances
Explicitly describes the arrangement as a "trade deal," "trade agreement," "trade memorandum," "trade pact," or uses substantially similar language indicating a formal trade arrangement
Involves at least one foreign country, territory, or international trade bloc

Preliminary agreements, frameworks, or agreements in principle do count as long as they are presented as a new trade-related agreement. It also includes modifications or re-negotiated versions of previous agreements. New arrangements include, but are not limited to:

Agreements with a country, territory, or trade bloc with which the United States does not currently have a comprehensive trade agreement
Agreements that cover trade sectors, industries, or product categories not previously covered by existing U.S. trade agreements with the same partner(s)
An agreement that establishes fundamentally different trade mechanisms, dispute resolution procedures, or regulatory frameworks compared to existing agreements with the same partner(s)

The following qualify as announcements that trigger the Payout Criterion:

A new bilateral trade agreement between the U.S. and another country
A new multilateral trade agreement involving the U.S. and multiple countries
Trade memoranda of understanding that establish new trade frameworks
Sector-specific trade deals (e.g., agricultural, technology, energy trade agreements)
Trade arrangements that are announced as "agreements in principle" or "framework agreements"

The following do NOT trigger the Payout Criterion:

Informal statements, leaks, or "sources say" reports without official presidential announcement
Announcements of trade negotiations beginning, trade talks being scheduled, or intentions to pursue trade deals
Tariff announcements, trade sanctions, or trade enforcement actions that do not establish new bilateral or multilateral trade frameworks
Congressional approval or ratification of previously announced deals
Announcements of trade visits, delegations, or diplomatic meetings without announcing an actual deal
Announcements regarding domestic trade policy changes that do not involve foreign partners

markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves cytisinicline for smoking cessation for marketing before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Oct 1, 2026, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves cytisinicline for smoking cessation after addressing the CRL concerns and before Oct 1, 2026.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves cytisinicline for smoking cessation anyway before Oct 1, 2026, the market will resolve to Yes.

If cytisinicline for smoking cessation receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Oct 1, 2026, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Oct 1, 2026, the market will resolve to No immediately.
markets.title: Will the FDA approve cytisinicline for smoking cessation before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Tesla or SpaceX officially announces a definitive, binding agreement for Tesla to acquire SpaceX, SpaceX to acquire Tesla, or the two entities to merge or combine in any structure that results in a transfer of controlling interest or consolidation of the two entities under common corporate ownership before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

This market resolves Yes regardless of which entity is the acquirer and which is the target. A Tesla acquisition of SpaceX, a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla, a reverse merger, or a stock-for-stock combination all satisfy the Payout Criterion equally, provided a definitive agreement is publicly announced.

A statement by Elon Musk shall only satisfy the Payout Criterion if it constitutes an unambiguous, affirmative confirmation of a definitive signed agreement — not an expression of intent, a hypothetical, a negotiation update, or a speculative comment about a future combination.

markets.rules_primary: If United States of America v. James Brien Comey, Jr. has been dismissed by the court or administrative body with jurisdiction after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A dismissal is defined as:

For Criminal Cases:
Dismissal of charges by prosecutor (nolle prosequi)
Court-ordered dismissal for constitutional violations
Dismissal for speedy trial violations
Dismissal for prosecutorial misconduct
Dismissal for insufficient evidence
Dismissal following successful motion to dismiss

The following do NOT constitute dismissals:
Settlement agreements between parties
Plea bargains or guilty pleas in criminal cases
Default judgments
Summary judgments on the merits
Trial verdicts (guilty, not guilty, liable, not liable)
Consent decrees or agreed orders
Cases transferred to different courts
Cases stayed or continued indefinitely
Bankruptcy discharge (which is a substantive resolution)
Cases resolved through alternative dispute resolution
Appeals or remands (unless the appellate court dismisses the case entirely)
Temporary restraining orders or preliminary injunctions
Administrative closure

If only some claims, counts, or defendants are dismissed while the case continues on other matters, this does NOT constitute a dismissal for purposes of this contract. The entire case must be dismissed.
markets.title: Will United States of America v. James Brien Comey, Jr. have their case dismissed before Oct 1, 2026?

A Chinese bank means an institution holding a banking licence from China's National Financial Regulatory Administration or from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. A designation naming only a subsidiary, branch, affiliate or parent counts only if the licensed bank itself is named, and one qualifying bank is sufficient.

Adding a qualifying bank to the SDN List or the CAPTA List, or a FinCEN final rule imposing a Section 311 special measure on one, resolves the market to YES. The stated reason for the designation is irrelevant, and a later delisting does not reverse a resolution already made.

A threat or reported plan, a civil penalty over past conduct, addition to the Commerce Entity List, sanctions by another government, or designation of a Chinese entity that is not a licensed bank, such as a payment processor, exchange house, refinery or trading firm, do NOT resolve the market to Yes.

markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from the Prime Minister of Canada qualifies for the purposes of this market. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The publication must expressly commit Canada to impose a new Canadian tariff or increase an existing Canadian tariff on U.S. goods. It must be an official speech, statement, or press release issued personally or in the prime minister's name. A specified future effective date qualifies.

Minister- or agency-only announcements, negotiating objectives, noncommittal statements of intent that do not expressly commit Canada, general aspirations, preliminary discussions, threats, conditional proposals, and the automatic activation or expiry of a previously announced measure do NOT qualify. A new decision to reimpose a previously removed tariff or increase an existing tariff qualifies. Reports merely referencing publications before Issuance do NOT qualify unless they explicitly reaffirm a qualifying new decision made after Issuance.
markets.title: Will the Prime Minister of Canada announce new or increased tariffs on U.S. goods before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Canada and the United States have concluded a final trade agreement after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement is concluded if either:

it is signed or formally executed by authorized officials of both governments, or
both governments announce that negotiations have concluded and that the agreed tariff changes are being implemented, or those tariff changes take legal effect in both countries under the agreement.

An agreement can be concluded even if individual sectors remain subject to further negotiation, and regardless of when the agreed changes take effect.

The following do NOT count:

Anything announced before Issuance, including the announcements of August 18 and 19, 2026 of a deal reached, agreed in principle, or pending final documentation, and any draft agreement reported before Issuance
An agreement announced as reached by only one of the two governments
A framework, term sheet, memorandum of understanding or joint communique that both governments describe as still subject to negotiation of its core terms
A temporary tariff pause, suspension or deadline extension not accompanied by a concluded agreement
Continued or resumed negotiations, however described
Action taken unilaterally by one government

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
markets.title: Will it be reported by a Source Agency that Canada and the United States have concluded a final trade agreement before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Ilie Bolojan leaves as Prime Minister of Romania before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Ilie Bolojan must have an actual departure date and vacate the role within the time period.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
markets.title: Will Ilie Bolojan be out as Prime Minister of Romania before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If physical construction work on federal border security infrastructure inside Big Bend National Park resumes after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

Only work inside the boundary of Big Bend National Park counts. Activity elsewhere along the border, including elsewhere in the Big Bend Border Patrol sector and on state or private land, is outside this market.

Federal border security infrastructure means patrol and access roads, vehicle barriers, fencing or wall, detection technology, surveillance towers, lighting and power lines installed for border security purposes. Work on any one component is enough, and it does not matter how the work is characterised by the agency or its contractors.

Qualifying work is physical: disturbing ground, or erecting or installing any of that infrastructure.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Surveying, mapping, environmental review or planning that does not disturb ground
Moving or staging equipment without physical work starting
Restoration, revegetation or remediation of ground disturbed before the pause
An announcement that work will resume on a future date
markets.title: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that physical construction work on federal border security infrastructure inside Big Bend National Park resumes before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Benjamin Netanyahu has been arrested before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, "arrested" means:
Being taken into physical custody by law enforcement authorities (including federal, state, local, military, or international law enforcement)
Voluntarily surrendering to law enforcement authorities in response to an arrest warrant
Being formally booked or processed following detention

The following scenarios would satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Benjamin Netanyahu is handcuffed and taken to a police station
Benjamin Netanyahu surrenders at a police station or courthouse with their attorney
Benjamin Netanyahu is arrested in any country and this is reported by a Source Agency
Benjamin Netanyahu is detained at an airport or border crossing and formally arrested

The following scenarios would NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
An arrest warrant being issued but not executed
Benjamin Netanyahu being briefly detained but not arrested
Benjamin Netanyahu being questioned or interviewed without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being placed under house arrest or electronic monitoring without physical custody
Benjamin Netanyahu being named in an indictment without arrest
Benjamin Netanyahu being arrested after Oct 1, 2026
Protective custody that is not an arrest
markets.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be arrested before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Anthropic announces a complete solution, developed by Anthropic or researchers collaborating directly with Anthropic on that solution, to one of the six Millennium Prize Problems unsolved as of September 5, 2026 before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying announcement must expressly state that Anthropic developed or co-developed the solution, or expressly identify outside researchers as having collaborated with Anthropic on developing that solution.

The qualifying problems are the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture, Hodge Conjecture, Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem, P versus NP, Riemann Hypothesis, and Yang-Mills existence and mass gap problem.

Work by an independent Claude user does NOT count, even if Anthropic publicizes it. Providing model access or research credits alone is not direct collaboration on the solution. Partial results, numerical evidence, or formalization of a previously known solution do NOT count as a complete solution.

Clay acceptance, peer review, and a prize award are not required.
markets.title: Will Anthropic announce a Millennium Prize solution before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the function is implemented.
markets.rules_primary: If an Anthropic product has implemented a general-purpose personal AI agent that remembers the user and starts multi-step tasks across third-party apps on its own before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The function must be live and processing user interactions, not explicitly labeled as "beta," "test," "experimental," "preview," or "early access" or similar, and officially acknowledged by the company through announcements, documentation, or help pages. Implementation includes direct integration into the product's interface, automatic application to user accounts, user-initiated activation through official controls, API implementation, or policy changes that operationally enforce the function. Announcements without deployment, employee-only testing, technical documentation without implementation, and third-party additions without authorization do not qualify. The implementation must occur in the United States unless otherwise specified. If it meets these conditions, it counts from the first date it is live for users outside the company, including in a gradual rollout or a waitlist, invitation-only, or paid-tier release.

A general-purpose personal AI agent acts for an individual user on that user's own goals, is not limited to a single category of task or app, such as only code, only documents, or only shopping, and (1) retains user-specific information, such as preferences, relationships, goals, or ongoing activities, across separate interactions, and (2) as a built-in capability, on its own initiative and outside any conversation or task the user has started, begins new multi-step actions across third-party apps, websites, or services to advance the user's ongoing goals, based on what it has retained. The agent must itself take at least one such action before asking the user anything, and may then pause for approval before a step such as sending a message or making a purchase. An action means changing something in a third-party app, website, or service on the user's behalf, such as sending, posting, booking, purchasing, submitting a form, or creating, editing, or deleting an item; reading, searching, or summarizing does not count. An agent focused on work qualifies if it acts across email, calendar, messaging, and the web for an individual user.

The following do not qualify: carrying out a task the user started, however long-running; running tasks on a user-defined schedule, event trigger, or monitor, or under a standing instruction that tells the agent what to do or which app, source, or workflow to watch; a briefing or notification on its own; a proposed task or suggestion that does nothing until the user accepts it; an offer made in reply to the user's message; memory alone; an agent configured by an organization to run shared team workflows; and a developer platform, SDK, or API for building agents, unless the company itself offers through it an agent that meets (1) and (2) for end users. A goal or preference the user has shared, from which the agent itself decides what new task to start, is not a standing instruction, and neither is turning the capability on, connecting apps, or granting permissions.
markets.title: Will Anthropic release a personal AI agent before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Samuel Alito retires as Supreme Court justice before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
markets.title: Will Samuel Alito announce their departure as Supreme Court justice before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: If an event described in the Payout Criterion occurs, expiration will be moved to an earlier date and time in accordance with Rule 7.2.
markets.rules_primary: If any AI lab solves another Millennium Prize Problem after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Millennium Prize Problem counts as solved on the first date that, by Expiration, remains unretracted and either:

A complete proof, disproof, or counterexample addressing the problem as originally formulated by the Clay Mathematics Institute is published in a reputable peer-reviewed mathematics or scientific journal.
CMI or another recognized academic governing or recognition body officially states that the problem has been resolved by reference to a specific written work.
At least two Source Agencies themselves report that the problem has been proven, disproven, or otherwise resolved by reference to a specific publicly available written work.

A preprint, announcement, blog post, conference presentation, technical report, or machine-checked formalization does NOT by itself constitute a solution, but may be the written work relied upon for official recognition or qualifying Source Agency reporting. Award of a Millennium Prize by CMI is NOT required.

Partial results, special cases, unrelated reformulations, results conditional on unproven assumptions, and findings that the problem is independent of or undecidable within its framework do NOT count. The result must establish the truth or falsity of the problem as originally formulated.

A solution is attributed to AI lab when Source Agencies report that AI lab, its personnel, or an AI system developed and operated by it produced the solution in whole or substantial part, and the lab or system is credited as an author, contributor, or producer. Collaborative work qualifies; independent third-party use of the lab's publicly available model or product without such participation or credit does NOT.

Each Millennium Prize Problem counts at most once. Problems solved before time period do NOT count. A purported solution that is retracted, withdrawn, repudiated, rescinded, disavowed, or reported to contain an unresolved identified error before Expiration does NOT count.
markets.title: Will any AI lab solve a Millennium Prize Problem before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_secondary: To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that the company has achieved, attained, reached, or developed Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), or that it has achieved, attained, reached, or developed “AGI.” Statements that describe “AGI-like,” “AGI-level,” “near-AGI,” or “toward AGI” systems without explicitly stating that the company has achieved/attained/reached/developed AGI do not qualify. For purposes of this market, a “company” includes any publicly traded company or any privately held company whose existence and corporate identity is verifiable and whose financing/valuation or corporate profile is covered by at least two of the listed major business news sources.

markets.rules_primary: If Ripple has the highest return out of BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), SOL (Solana), XRP (Ripple), and HYPE (Hyperliquid) in from Sep 30 - 11:30PM EDT to 11:45PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The return for each cryptocurrency in the specified set is calculated independently over the given time period using the formula: Return = (Ending Price − Starting Price) / Starting Price × 100. The Starting Price and Ending Price are defined as the time-weighted average of the Spot Rate values published by CFBenchmarks during the 60-second intervals immediately preceding the start and end of the time period, respectively. Final returns are calculated on an identical basis for every cryptocurrency in the set and rounded to three decimal places (as a percentage).

If two or more cryptocurrencies report an identical return (rounded to three decimal places) such that they are tied for the highest
position, each tied cryptocurrency's Contract will resolve to "Yes" with a value equal to $1 divided by the number of cryptocurrencies tied for the highest position,
rounded down to the nearest cent, and each remaining (non-tied) cryptocurrency's
Contract will resolve to "No."
